test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'living inside houses' is coded as 'ca de mo'.

'snow houses built' is coded as 'ni tp ca',

'living with snow man' is coded as 'vr hs ni mo".

(Note: All codes are two letter codes only)

If 'built with brick' is coded as 'vr aj tp', what is the probable code for 'brick man' in the given code language?
solution:
The code for each word is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/416cf2599b4c856fca7e0ac6c4d184542335f241c62a9026c92dc124ca56c07d.png] 

 
• The code for brick is aj and for man - hs

So, the code for brick man will be either 'aj hs' or 'hs aj'.

Hence, ‘**hs aj**’ is the correct answer.
